comparator.claim: The display order is a sort descending by (PTS, GD8, F) where GD8 is the low byte of (F - A) interpreted signed 8-bit, PTS an unsigned byte and F an unsigned 16-bit word; a club never swaps past a neighbour with different PTS, so the points order comes from the quicksort and the (GD8, F) order only within equal points.
comparator.structure: five groups of 16 clubs (divisions), sorted independently
comparator.stability: the bubble pass only swaps on strict inequalities, so equal-key clubs keep the quicksort's arrangement; the capture holds no club pair equal in (PTS, GD8, F), so the recorded confirmation is fully determined
